answer.rationale: The incumbent cannot meet the mandated 18% reduction and has refused to reopen price, while the low-cost vendor meets the target alone. However, with expiry in 14 days, no auto-renewal, and the line at 94% committed volume, a full unvalidated migration could create disproportionate delivery risk. Verify the prior low-cost-vendor onboarding and performance record, plus the incumbent stability record, before committing; structure any switch with guarded qualification, transition controls, and contingency coverage where possible.
